title: Afonso I of Kongo protests illegal enslavement
place: Kingdom of Kongo (present-day Angola and DR Congo)
summary: Kongo's Christian king Afonso I wrote to the King of Portugal that traders kidnapped his people every day, even nobles' sons and his own family. He demanded Kongolese law be obeyed and set up a board to regulate trade.
why: A written African voice from inside the early slave trade, protesting the enslavement of free Kongolese.

notes.problem: Overclaim: source says Afonso protested illegal enslavement of freeborn Kongolese and set up a board to regulate the trade; 'asked that Kongo not become a slave-trade hub' is not in the source.
